theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_stab_tangent_projection
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ u : Euclid P, (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection u = A₀.starProjection u - inner ℝ (ν x) u • ν x) ∧ (ContinuousOn ν M → ∀ u : Euclid P, ContinuousOn (fun x => (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection u) M)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
